notes: Draft evidence contract only. A phase string cannot satisfy a transition gate. Operative F1 requires one content-addressed F0→F1 transition whose approved payload binds the exact F1 independent-role and delegation evidence references. Operative F2 requires both that validated prior F0→F1 record and a current F1→F2 record whose approved payload binds the prior transition digest and the exact F2 control-separation, audit/review and role-replacement evidence references, so maturity evidence cannot be substituted after Members vote. The prior F1 transition must itself have satisfied the F1 Active-Member, independent-role and effective treasury/domain/repository delegation criteria on its own effective date; later F2 maturity cannot retroactively cure an invalid F1 transition. Current F1/F2 maturity evidence must bind the exact phase-effective date, be completed by that date, and rely only on supporting evidence captured by that date. F2 role-replacement evidence must additionally bind a real validated delegation lifecycle: a prior delegation, its adopted revocation and a distinct successor delegation for the same scopes/resources/actions, with the successor role held by a different non-founder person and the replacement lifecycle occurring only after F1 has been validly established. Historical institutional authority for admissions and lifecycle actions is derived from validated transition dates rather than trusted from a self-declared phase label.
